close_reason: Deferred: commit already made; noted for future commits to use plain-English rationale
description: Commit message body lists '(1vdc.13)', '(1vdc.20)' etc. but does not explain why each change was made. A reader with no access to the beads tracker cannot understand the intent. The subject 'JMAP-1vdc.* cleanup' also says nothing about what was cleaned up or why. A first-time contributor reading git log will have no idea what problem these renames solved. Each bullet should include a one-clause why, e.g. 'sort_thread_email_ids: skip sort for single-element threads (no-op was allocating a Vec needlessly)'.
title: commit message uses opaque issue IDs without rationale
